verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a programmatic path to opening a deposit account. You create a customer as a PROSPECT, then fill in the rest and activate it, run KYC/KYB verification through the API, and create SAVING/CHECKING demand deposit accounts. A Sandbox environment is available as soon as an API key is issued, and sandbox test cases cover the verification flows. However, nothing in the evidence states the accounts are FDIC-insured or describes the bank-partner backing at the account level. Sandbox-to-production parity is only implied, and the end-to-end transition from application to active account is not spelled out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deposit insurance, explicit sandbox/production parity for account opening, a documented account status lifecycle from application to active, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch
